description:
Enumerable/protocol-dispatch fixtures fail materialization with 'error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: materialization reached unresolved multi-target direct callsite N; dispatch must be settled upstream' (and a sibling transport assertion). The planner leaves a protocol/multi-target callsite unmonomorphized.

Fixtures (fixtures2/behavior), run+interp+build unless noted:
- membership_operator, range_enumerable, enumerable_protocol_dispatch, enum_take_drop_split, enum_map_family — 'unresolved multi-target direct callsite'.
- enum_predicate_search — surfaces instead as a compiler assertion at src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs:119 (likely same root: dispatch not settled before transport).
- bsx_guard_eq — interp selects a different branch (also noted in fz-rh2.16.2).

Settle protocol/multi-target dispatch upstream so these callsites monomorphize. Related: fz-9i4.5 (same-arity tuple selective receive — different surface, same 'dispatch must be settled' family).
title: [BUG] Compiler2 multi-target protocol/Enumerable dispatch not settled upstream
